title: Parameter scans for reduced Curie temperature and molecular‑field ratio
action: For discrete values of each exchange parameter J1′, J2′, J2, and J3 (with all other parameters set to zero) covering the ranges specified in the task, numerically solve the two linearized Bethe–Peierls self‑consistency equations to obtain the reduced Curie temperature k_B T_c / J_1 and the molecular‑field ratio μ_1/λ_1. Write the full scan results as a CSV.
description: CSV with one row per scan point. Each row gives the parameter name, its value in units of J1, the resulting k_B T_c / J_1, and μ_1/λ_1. The scan covers the ranges described in the problem background.
output_schema: Columns: parameter (string, one of 'J1′', 'J2′', 'J2', 'J3'), parameter_value (float, in units of J1), kB_Tc_over_J1 (float), mu1_over_lambda1 (float). Rows ordered by parameter name and ascending parameter_value.

title: Ferromagnetic instability point from J1′ scan
action: Using the J1′ scan results, identify the critical value of J1′/J1 at which the reduced Curie temperature k_B T_c / J_1 first drops to negligible (≤ 1e‑6), indicating the loss of ferromagnetic order, and report this critical value together with the corresponding μ_1/λ_1 in a single‑row CSV.
description: Single‑row CSV reporting the instability condition for the nearest‑neighbour biquadratic exchange. The row contains the parameter name, the critical J1′/J1 value, the near‑zero Tc, and μ_1/λ_1.
output_schema: Columns: parameter (string: 'J1′'), critical_value (float), kB_Tc_over_J1 (float, expected ≈ 0), mu1_over_lambda1 (float).
